name: Coconut (Fresh)
siboNotes: Fresh coconut is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. The high fat content may slow digestion, so start with smaller portions if sensitive.
preparationTips: Pierce coconut eyes with skewer and drain liquid before cracking
Use coconut meat grater or vegetable peeler for thin shreds
Store fresh coconut meat in refrigerator for up to 5 days
Freeze shredded coconut in portions for easy use
